title: adenophora capillaris subsp. paniculata
intro: Adenophora capillaris subsp. paniculata, commonly known as  "Panax ginseng of the East" or  "False ginseng", is a perennial plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to improve cardiovascular health and reduce the risk of certain diseases. The therapeutic actions of Adenophora capillaris subsp. paniculata include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve fatigue, and improve cognitive function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
